workLog.action: ran the adr-review 6-agent debate across four non-Claude model families
workLog.evidence: architect on gemini-3.1-pro, critic on gpt-5.6-sol, independent-thinker on grok-4.5, analyst on gpt-5.5, security on gpt-5.6-terra, tie-break by high-level-advisor. Model diversity was deliberate so the review did not inherit the author model's blind spots.

architect returned BLOCK because the explanation used an indented narrative instead of the document's Rationale convention. analyst found the Rationale asserted the session log itself is skipped by the lint step, which is false because the log is .json and the command filters *.md. Rewrote the Rationale to cite the real mechanism, sessions that edit markdown under the ignored prefixes.

workLog.action: re-measured every number in the Rationale rather than citing the issue
workLog.evidence: Issue #3710 recorded 89.7% of tracked markdown as excluded. Measuring the current config against the current tree gave 2912 of 4020, or 72.4%, because PR #4065 removed the skill-tree exclusions. Also verified .claude/skills/** is no longer an ignored prefix and dropped it from the citation.

independent-thinker argued the root cause is the exclusion policy, not the protocol text, and that this change makes the green loud rather than making it real. Accepted the framing, kept the scope: un-excluding .agents/** is an ADR-sized decision with an evidenced cost from PR #4065, where removing skill-tree exclusions surfaced 823 violations.

critic on gpt-5.6-sol found the document would contradict itself: the new Verification bullet demanded a file count while the Session End checklist and the investigation-only log example still taught 'Lint output clean'. Confirmed at lines 921 and 1000, updated both so the document teaches one evidence contract.

workLog.action: adopted the reviewers' shared remedy without their proposed severity change

workLog.action: closed the 6-agent adr-review debate and filed the one deferred finding
workLog.evidence: high-level-advisor (gemini-3.1-pro) returned the tie-breaker: Accept, ADR-043 File issue, Priority Land now. Final tally 6/6 Accept or Disagree-and-Commit: architect ACCEPT after one BLOCK, analyst BLOCK resolved, independent-thinker D&C, critic BLOCK with its P0 fixed, security D&C with both Mediums adopted, advisor ACCEPT. The advisor overruled the architect on ADR-043, on the ground that a stale claim and a mechanically wrong claim are different objects, and scoped the remedy to an appended correction rather than a rewrite so the historical record the architect defends survives. Filed as issue #4401. Verified the ADR text before quoting it: line 60 reads 'ensuring only specified files are processed', and .markdownlint-cli2.yaml lines 90 to 97 document the opposite, that globs was removed because it ADDS files and that ignores stays so explicit walks still honor exclusions. Dropped the 72.4 percent figure from the issue for the same reason it was dropped from the protocol text: it drifts, and it is already stale in three checked-in copies.
